slice: W210: direct ordinary Dynamic JSON physical/public Object composition

claim.scope: Direct ordinary JSON actuals at bound Dynamic sites reuse the existing Object physical serde in the finite executed Wide-part profiles; public column read/write and existing recursive/nominal-JSON table routes are qualified.
claim.adversary_verdict: ROBUST within the declared finite source/test/native scope, not all type/layout products or whole-project closure.
claim.overall_goal: IN_PROGRESS: generic Dynamic table consumer, remaining composition/layout contracts, MV/projections and broad decomposition remain open; memory/performance optimization is deferred.
claim.review_limitation: Luna implementation/source reviews are same-lineage correlated. Root independently inspects source/literals, executes bounded DEBUG/RELEASE/native workloads and unchanged-test defect seeds, and verifies exact restoration.

implementation.root_cause: Reusable leaf serde needs contextual container metadata, physical names/profiles and distinct P/Q/R domains. Passing the ordinary String profile into Object shared MAP created matching writer/reader errors absent from stock parts.
implementation.architecture: DynamicJsonObjectPhysicalSite and DynamicJsonObjectSiteCoordinates each have one source file. Existing Dynamic traversal binds/collects/reconstructs JSON via BinaryJsonObjectAdapter and ObjectDocumentCodec; no per-product JSON serializer.

tested_source_identity.encoding: SHA256(JSON.pretty_generate(sorted [path,size,SHA256] rows)+newline) for all src/spec files

invariants: Parent Dynamic actual rosters precede child Object discovery; exact site/canonical-arm/type bindings include unused JSON arms.
Physical parent P, Dynamic occurrence Q and selected JSON R remain distinct; Object children retain P in every physical mark, including Q=0/R=0.
Recursive Array/Tuple carriers retain outer physical P, not their flattened tuple cardinality.
Child physical roles are separate from ordinary roles, merged into exact part rosters with escaped/raw/hashed collision checks.
Typed and Dynamic child String serde inherits ordinary profile; Object shared MAP uses independent default single_stream profile.
ArrayElements advances Array level without inventing an .elements physical-name component.
BASIC/COMPACT framing is normalized by the existing framing owner before the normalized census.
All bound children and all marks are eagerly validated/decoded before window return; empty table candidate selections replay validation before callbacks on the admitted dispatch route.
Adaptation, Object serde, binding/census work and inherited depth borrow existing cumulative budgets.
Both staged publishers compare JSON paths/counts/recursive values before publication, not only ordinary byte/child fields.

boundaries.admitted: Direct ordinary Dynamic JSON arms in the declared physical profiles, public root/ArrayDynamic columns and tested recursive carriers; explicit writer bindings and persisted reader discovery.
rejected_or_open: Generic direct-Dynamic table batch accessor is not qualified by column-reader admission.
Wrapped/composite JSON actuals, SharedVariant inline JSON and Object path Dynamic JSON actuals lacking child bindings.
JSON SKIP/SKIP REGEXP and other unsupported physical layouts/type products.
Source-part live mutation; quiescent parts are required.
PartStreamSource checks declared names and sizes, not every whole-file checksum hash.
No lazy/selected-window cost, RSS, performance, all-type or MV/projection claim.
Staged comparator negative tests plus source ordering are not exhaustive staged fault-injection/publication atomicity or global callback atomicity.
Adjacent inherited Interval/SimpleAggregate/AggregateCount/QBit owner-accounting and non-JSON outer SharedVariant depth gaps remain separate.
boundaries.native_shared_map_scope: Native shared MAP values are empty; default profile/roster are witnessed, not every nonempty shared-data layout.
boundaries.legal_type_products: ClickHouse LowCardinality checks inner canBeInsideLowCardinality(); base codec support does not legalize every nesting.

primary_source_anchors.law: Typed and Dynamic child settings propagation is separate from shared MAP.
ArraySizes names .sizeN; ArrayElements increments level without a name suffix.

unsuccessful_or_corrected_probes.observation: Monolithic 188-file RELEASE compile killed at 12592400KB > 12288MB after ~233s; no test-failure claim. Four disjoint groups retain exact union/cap.

Stock-authored parts exposed inherited String profile wrongly applied to Object shared MAP; four physical call sites fixed after independent literal RED.
After profile correction all four helper cases succeed but native Array prefix oracle invents .elements; corrected from independent pinned source law/self-test.
